compare.intro: This unit's points come in look-alike pairs: ので and から both give a reason (ので is softer and more polite) while のに joins two things that do not match; し lists reasons and a request can follow it, while a て-reason leads only to a result or a feeling; 間 fills the whole time while 間に is one action at some point inside it; まで keeps going up to a point while までに is one action done before it; ながら is one person doing two things at once while 間 can join two people; and うちに means do it while a state lasts, while 前に only looks at the time before an action.

forms.ja: 店長が来る{まで}、店の前で[待|ま]ちました。
forms.en: I waited in front of the shop until the manager came.

forms.tag: しめきり · by (one action before a point)
forms.ja: 店長が来る{までに}、そうじをしておきました。
forms.en: I had done the cleaning by the time the manager came.

forms.tag: その中で一回 · at some point during
forms.ja: 店長がいない{間に}、[昼|ひる]ごはんを食べました。
forms.en: While the manager was out, I ate lunch.

check.label: アルバイトの前に
check.q: アルバイトが[始|はじ]まる（　　）、^ずっと^駅の前の[本屋|ほんや]にいました。
why: までに is for one action done before a point, like 出す or [帰|かえ]る. ずっと…いました went on the whole time, so it needs まで.
間に needs a stretch of time, like [待|ま]っている間に. [始|はじ]まる happens in a moment, and ずっと fills the whole time anyway.
I stayed at the bookshop the whole time, up to when my job started: ずっと goes with まで.

drill.label: Choose the form
drill.q: ^毎日れんしゅうした^（　　）、[試合|しあい]にまけてしまいました。
why: ので gives a reason, but practising every day is not why you lose.
Practising every day and still losing is not what you expected: のに joins two things that do not match.
から gives a reason, like ので. Practising is not the reason for losing.
し lists reasons that point the same way. Practising every day does not point to losing.

drill.label: Choose the form
drill.q: 雨が（　　）、^かさを[持|も]っていってください^。
why: A て-reason leads to a result or a feeling, not to a request like [持|も]っていってください. A request needs から.
のに joins two things that do not match. Rain and taking an umbrella match.
The rain is the reason and a request follows, so から.
ながら is one person doing two things at once. It is the rain that falls, and you who take the umbrella.

drill.label: Choose the form
drill.q: 母が[料理|りょうり]をしている（　　）、わたしは^ずっと^テレビを見ていました。
why: ずっと…見ていました fills the whole time mother was cooking, so 間 with no に.
間に is for one action at some point inside the time. ずっと fills the whole time.
ながら is one person doing two things at once. Here mother cooks and I watch TV: two people.
With うちに, the second part is something done before a state ends, or a change that comes while it lasts. ずっとテレビを見ていました is neither; it just fills the time.

drill.label: Choose the form
drill.q: ^ひまな^（　　）、へやのそうじをしておきます。
why: 前に follows a verb in the dictionary form or a noun with の, as in 仕事の前に. It does not join a な-adjective like ひまな.
までに sets a deadline after a time or a verb. ひまなまでに is not a form.
まで follows a time or a verb, as in [暗|くら]くなるまで. ひまなまで is not a form.
うちに can follow a な-adjective with な: clean while you are still free, before you get busy.

drill.label: Build the sentence
drill.hint: まで follows the dictionary form. Who is reading while waiting?
drill.full: 電車が来る{まで}本を読みながら[待|ま]ちました。
drill.explain: 来る, まで, 本を, 読みながら. The waiting went on until the train came, so まで, not までに. I read and waited at the same time, one person doing both, so ながら: I waited for the train, reading a book.

drill.label: Build the sentence
drill.hint: し lists the first reason. The last reason is in the plain form, right before ので.
drill.full: このアルバイトは[家|いえ]から[近|ちか]いし[昼|ひる]ごはんも出る{ので}、[好|す]きです。
drill.explain: 家から, 近いし, 昼ごはんも, 出る. し lists the first reason, and も on the second reason goes with it. 出る in the plain form joins ので: I like this job because it is close to home, and lunch is given too.

exam.label: Choose the form
exam.q: この　店の　ラーメンは　高い（　　）、あまり　おいしく　ないです。
exam.explain: You expect an expensive bowl of ramen to be good, but it is not, so のに. ので and から give a reason, and being expensive is not why it tastes bad. うちに means while a state lasts, which does not fit a shop's prices and its taste.

exam.label: Choose the form
exam.q: 母が　買い物に　行って　いる（　　）、へやを　そうじして　おきました。
exam.explain: Mother was out for a while, and I did the cleaning at one point inside that time, so 間に. ながら is one person doing two things at once, and here there are two people. 行っているまでに and 行っているまえに are not forms; you would need 帰ってくるまでに or 帰ってくるまえに.

exam.label: Build the sentence
exam.before: あしたは　テストが
exam.full: あしたは　テストが　ある　ので　{今夜は}　おそく　まで　勉強します。
exam.explain: ある, ので, 今夜は, おそく. テストがある is the reason, and ので follows the plain form. おそく goes right before まで (until late): I have a test tomorrow, so tonight I will study until late.

scene.ja: 食堂のアルバイトのシフト
scene.en: A shift timetable for a part-time job at a cafeteria
scene.intro: Tap each word on the cafeteria's shift timetable for its part-time staff.

check.label: How the exam asks it
check.q: 来週の　月曜日は　_都合_が　悪いです。
check.explain: 都合 (convenience) is read つごう: 都 is ツ here, and 合 is ゴウ. 都 is ト in a word like 東京都, but とごう is not a word, and neither are つあい and とあい.

skill.ask: Does Lin have to change anything on Thursday the 12th?
skill.passage:
さくら食堂　アルバイトの　シフト（十一月九日～十五日）
曜日　　　　朝（七時～十一時）　夕方（五時～九時）
月・水・金　リン　　　　　　　　キム
^火・木　　　田中　　　　　　　　リン^
土・日　　　キム　　　　　　　　田中
※朝の　店員は、開店の　三十分前までに　来て　ください。
※^休みたい　日が　ある　人は、七日（土）までに　店長に　言って　ください^。代わりの　人は　店長が　さがします。
skill.strategy: Find Lin's name in the Thursday row and see which column it is in before you read the notes.

item.q: リンさんは　十二日（木）の　朝　九時から　十二時まで、大学で　試験が　あります。リンさんは　どう　しますか。
options: 七日までに　店長に　言って、十二日は　休む。
キムさんに　十二日の　夕方の　仕事を　たのむ。
十二日の　朝、店長に　電話して　休む。
十二日も　いつもと　同じように　夕方　働く。
short: いつもと同じように夕方働く
item.explain: On Tuesdays and Thursdays Lin works in the evening, from five to nine: 火・木 … リン is in the 夕方 column. The test is in the morning, so nothing changes and she works in the evening as usual.
why: Lin does not need a day off. On Thursday she works only in the evening, after the test.
Lin can do her own evening shift. And the notes say the manager finds the substitute: 代わりの　人は　店長が　さがします.
Lin works on Thursday evening, not in the morning, so she does not need to call. A day off must also be asked for by the 7th, not on the day.
